# Digital Estate Planner Skill for Muse

Organize your digital life so that in case of death, incapacity, or emergency, your loved ones can access what they need — without guessing passwords, hunting for accounts, or losing irreplaceable data. It builds a tiered digital inventory (critical access, financial assets, digital memories, ongoing services), helps you designate a digital executor and draft their instruction letter, covers password-manager inheritance features (1Password Emergency Kit, Bitwarden Emergency Access, Apple Legacy Contact, Google Inactive Account Manager), documents crypto wallets and seed phrases securely, sets social-media legacy wishes (Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn), and preserves photos — with an annual review checklist. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: account examples are US-centric (SSA, IRS, Verizon) — adapt to your country; and while it documents where seed phrases live, never paste real seed phrases or passwords into the chat — this skill plans your documentation, it doesn't vault your secrets. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
